# Project Instructions

## Project

Agentic Documentation Sync is a Node.js application used to demonstrate automated technical documentation synchronization.

## Technology

- Node.js 20+
- Express 5
- Jest
- GitHub Actions

## Entry Point

src/index.js

## Testing

Tests are located under the tests directory.

## Configuration

Environment variable names may be documented, but secret values must never be committed to the repository.

## Documentation

Technical documentation is maintained under the docs directory and README.md.
